{{Quote|We're approaching Krake's Planet, my Lord. And we've just received word that a skirmish has broken out at the main data complex.|[[Unidentified Imperial captain (Executor, Krake's Planet)|Unidentified Imperial captain]] to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 63">[[Star Wars (1977) 63|''Star Wars'' (1977) 63]]</ref>}}
The '''skirmish''' at the [[Krake Data Vault]] took place in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] on [[Krake's Planet]] between elements of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] infiltrated the Imperial Krake Data Vault and secured secret background information on [[Lumiya|Shira Brie]], revelaing her to be an undercover Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]].
